description: First of two desert-camouflaged Su-7s flanking the approach road to the administrative block (Alan Warnes/Flypast 2001, warbirds.in). Bhuj never operated Su-7s; probably ex-Jamnagar. Painted B911 (not cross-checked against records).
Second of two Su-7s at the administrative block approach, painted B912 (warbirds.in).

Canberra B(I)58 (c/n 71618) in dayglo target-towing scheme painted F-971 near the base gate; reported in poor condition by Sandeep Unnithan (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak IF-971 "gate guardian painted").
Unidentified Hunter in "Hunter Park" near the AFS Bhuj gate, poor condition, serial not observed (warbirds.in). Distinguished from the other Bhuj airframes by type.
